title: Route UserProfileHeaderCard through feature barrels instead of 6 deep cross-feature imports; settings.dart barrel is dead (Rule 2)

evidence.quote: // Import this barrel (features/settings/settings.dart) from outside this

why: Rule 2 requires cross-feature references go through a barrel; UserProfileHeaderCard instead reaches directly into 3 files under features/account and 3 under features/profiles. Meanwhile features/settings/settings.dart -- the feature's only declared public surface, per its own header comment -- exports nothing and a repo-wide grep shows zero files import it. This is invisible in the audit baseline because the Makefile's own Rule-2 checker (make audit check 15/15, learning_tracker/Makefile:374-386) is broken: its awk step compares the feature name parsed from the file-path column against the feature name parsed from the FIRST 'features/X/' match in the whole grep line, which is always the importing file's own path (it appears before the import statement in `grep -n` output) -- so a[1] always equals b[1] and the WARN branch can never fire, for any file, repo-wide. I confirmed this by running the exact Makefile pipeline against this file: it produced zero matches despite the 6 genuine cross-feature imports above. Concrete cost: renaming/restructuring AppUser, AuthState or ProfileModel inside account/profiles breaks this widget with no barrel boundary to absorb the change, and nothing in CI would warn about it even though Rule 2 is nominally 'enforced'.
recommendation: Either populate settings.dart (and account's/profiles' equivalents) with a real public surface and route UserProfileHeaderCard's imports through them, or delete the dead settings.dart if the barrel convention is being abandoned. Separately, fix the awk field-comparison in Makefile check 15/15 so it diffs the importing file's own feature (from the path column) against the feature parsed specifically from the `package:learning_tracker/features/...` import string, not the first match in the whole line.
acceptance_criteria: make audit check 15/15 flags a deliberately-reintroduced cross-feature deep import in a scratch file (proves the checker actually fires)
user_profile_header_card.dart imports account/profiles symbols only via their barrels, or settings.dart is removed if the barrel convention is dropped

corrections: coding-standards.md's actual Rule 2 text names `providers.dart` as the sole sanctioned barrel, not `<feature>.dart` — settings.dart is not really 'the' correct target either. Also verified account.dart (populated, real exports) and profiles.dart (empty, like settings.dart) both have zero repo-wide importers too — the dead-barrel problem is systemic across features, broader than the single file reported, not narrower. This strengthens rather than weakens the finding.
